description: Lead SCORE (High/Medium/Low — is this lead worth pursuing, and how hard) to fixed-action mapping. Single source of truth read by the system prompt and the dashboard UI. v2 replaces the earlier 4-tier priority_tier taxonomy with an explicit High/Medium/Low lead score, per direct request: a simple, visible scoring matrix a judge can read at a glance, distinct from the SLA/urgency mechanism which is handled separately (see lead_completeness_check.js's expected_sla_hours inference and detect_leads.mjs).

scores.name: High — strong intent, worth immediate effort
trigger_signals: high-loss segment (tier1 city + SUV interest) or repeat/referral customer
test drive requested, or clearly overdue against its expected response window with no negative signal
scores.action_description: Call the lead within the hour and offer a same-day test drive slot for their vehicle of interest.

scores.name: Medium — standard intent, normal handling
trigger_signals: no strong positive or negative signal either way
within its expected response window, ordinary segment
scores.action_description: Contact via the lead's preferred available channel within the expected response window.

scores.name: Low — weak intent or going cold
trigger_signals: 2+ contact attempts with no test drive requested and no sign of recent engagement
profile otherwise suggests low urgency and low conversion likelihood
scores.action_description: Move to a low-touch digital nurture sequence (email/SMS) rather than urgent outreach; re-engage promptly if interest signals increase.
